Rajeev — thanks for the clear summary and timing. Really appreciate the staged approach; that maps well to how customers successfully minimize cutover risk.

We can offer a two-stage renewal + expansion:
1) Stage 1 (Q1 cutover): Private analytics enclave (isolated VPC) — includes 2 reserved inference clusters, prefix/KV cache isolation, and SOC-aligned audit logs. Target provisioning: 6–8 weeks after SOW sign.
2) Stage 2 (Q2 cutover): On-prem satellite cluster (air-gap option) — includes on-prem package, airgap transport tooling, and on-site install window. Target provisioning: 8–12 weeks after Stage 1 sign-off.

Term & commercial suggestion: move to a 24-month committed term on the dedicated/private line to secure capacity; we can apply a 10% committed discount and provide a one-time onboarding credit to offset the on-prem install.

I've attached a draft SOW and a simple network diagram for your infra team to review (Draft-SOW-PrivExpansion_v2.pdf, Network-Diagram.png). Can you confirm the following so I can pull numbers with our pricing/ops teams?
- Confirm whether the EU on-prem site requires air-gapped transport (no outbound egress) or if an isolated connector is acceptable.
- Expected steady-state qps and peak token throughput per second for analytics workloads.
- Desired SLA/uptime target for the analytics enclave (we have standard 99.9% or enterprise 99.95% tiers).

If that looks reasonable, I'll loop in Pricing and Infra with a request for a formal cost estimate and install schedule. Happy to set a 30-minute call next week to walk the SOW.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Vanessa / team —

Quick response with constraints and estimates (quoting the client plan):

Air-gap / On-prem:
- If true air-gap (no egress), we need to include our on-prem package + physical transfer tooling (sneakernet options) or a secure one-way transfer appliance. That adds ~2–3 weeks to procurement and an extra 5–7 engineering days for packaging and validation.
- Hardware: for an EU analytics satellite supporting their described load I'd budget 3 racks: each rack with 4xA100-equivalent nodes (can tune down if quantized), plus one standby node per site.

Private analytics enclave (isolated VPC):
- 2 reserved clusters: assume 16 p50 throughput baseline; suggest enabling prefix caching and KV isolation.
- Timeline: 6–8 weeks realistic if client has network approvals; earlier if we run in our Dedicated region as a stopgap (we can seed capacity in 3 weeks).

SLA & Ops:
- 99.95% requires additional cross-zone redundancy; price uplift ~12%.
- Audit log retention 12 months OK but will add to storage costs (we should surface per-GB/month).

Estimate numbers (very rough/OOM):
- Stage 1 (Private VPC): $225k one-time onboarding + $45k/month committed (pre-discount).
- Stage 2 (On-prem): $180k one-time (hardware packaging, shipping, install) + $12k/month support.

I’ll convert these to a formal cost worksheet and return by Mon EOD (30 Nov). Need confirmation from Sales on the proposed 10% discount band and onboarding credit before we finalize numbers.

—Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
